cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(atlas_routing_engine LANGUAGES CXX)
option(ATLAS_BUILD_TESTS "Build Atlas standalone tests and six-engine benchmark" ON)
option(ATLAS_SANITIZE "Enable address/undefined sanitizers" OFF)
if(ATLAS_SANITIZE AND NOT MSVC)
  add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
if(NOT TARGET weather_routing_engine)
  set(WEATHER_ROUTING_ENGINE_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(WEATHER_ROUTING_ENGINE_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  add_subdirectory(../weather-routing-engine weather-routing-engine)
endif()
add_library(atlas_routing_engine STATIC src/Engine.cpp)
add_library(weather_routing_engine::atlas ALIAS atlas_routing_engine)
target_compile_features(atlas_routing_engine PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(atlas_routing_engine PUBLIC include
  PRIVATE ../weather-routing-engine/src)
target_link_libraries(atlas_routing_engine PUBLIC weather_routing_engine)
set_target_properties(atlas_routing_engine PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(atlas_routing_engine PRIVATE /W4 /permissive-)
else()
  target_compile_options(atlas_routing_engine PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
if(ATLAS_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
